example_sentences_in_bangla: তার বাড়ি ডালভাঙা ক্রোশ দূরে অবস্থিত।
যাত্রাটি ডালভাঙা ক্রোশের মতো লম্বা হয়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: His house is a country mile away.
The journey turned out to be a marathon's distance.
history: This idiom likely originates from rural Bengali traditions of measuring long distances on foot, where paths through forests or fields might involve breaking branches to mark the way.
note: Evokes imagery of arduous rural travel in Bengali culture.
